title: Landing page refresh: replace carousel with 4 uploaded screenshots, align branding to tree-heart logo style, and update favicon

requirements.text: Replace the landing page product screenshot carousel images with the 4 uploaded app screenshots (IMG_1297.jpeg, IMG_1298.jpeg, IMG_1299.jpeg, IMG_1300.jpeg), removing all existing carousel images and updating the carousel to support 4 slides (swipe, next/prev, dots).

quotes: We should use all 4 photos that were uploaded to replace all the current photos in the carousel.
Remove all existing photos and redesign to better fit the 4 photos uploaded.

acceptanceCriteria: Landing carousel displays exactly 4 slides sourced from the uploaded files (not the existing /assets/generated/landing-screenshot-*.png files).
Swipe on mobile moves between all 4 slides; desktop prev/next buttons and dots navigate correctly.
No old placeholder “Amour Bloom” images appear anywhere in the carousel.

requirements.text: Redesign the landing page hero section to showcase the 4 uploaded screenshots in a clean, modern device-frame style carousel (or equivalent polished screenshot presentation), replacing the current static hero illustration while keeping the existing hero headline, subheadline, and CTA intact.

quotes: Remove all existing photos and redesign to better fit the 4 photos uploaded.
please proceed with the landing page changes that we discussed.

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section no longer renders the current hero illustration image; it instead features the uploaded screenshots in a cohesive presentation optimized for mobile and desktop.
Hero headline/subheadline/CTA remain present and readable across breakpoints.
Hero layout remains visually balanced (no overflow/cropping issues on common mobile widths).

requirements.text: Ensure the uploaded screenshots are used only within the landing page hero and/or landing screenshot carousel, and are not added to other app pages.

quotes: We don't need to add these photos anywhere else on the app.

acceptanceCriteria: No new references to the uploaded screenshot assets exist outside landing-page-related components/pages.

requirements.text: Update landing-page branding imagery to match the uploaded tree-and-hearts logo inspiration (86096FC5-864D-4BBF-9400-34F371353585-1.JPG): ensure the landing header logo (top-left), any landing thumbnails/brand marks, and footer logo are visually consistent and use the same logo artwork across the landing page.

quotes: We do need to make sure we correct the other images on the landing page to better fit the previous logo design I provided earlier. For example, in the top left corner.
I'd just like to make sure the design is similar and the same logo is used across the landing page.

acceptanceCriteria: Landing header logo (top-left) and footer logo are visually consistent with the tree-and-hearts inspiration and match each other (no mixed logo styles).
Any other landing-page brand marks/thumbnails use the same landing logo artwork/style (no mismatched branding on landing).

requirements.text: Update the browser favicon/app icon to match the same landing-page logo artwork/style, and wire it into the static HTML so it appears in the browser tab.

quotes: I'm thinking we update the landing-page logo and thumbnails, as well as the favicon/app icon in the browser tab.

acceptanceCriteria: A favicon is present and visible in the browser tab and matches the landing logo style.
favicon assets are served as static frontend assets and referenced from frontend/index.html.

requirements.text: Fix the landing page light/dark mode toggle so that toggling updates the landing page styling immediately and persistently (via the existing ThemeProvider/ThemeContext), including the landing background gradients and card backgrounds.

quotes: Fix the light/dark mode toggle so it works correctly with Tailwind.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the theme toggle on the landing page reliably switches between light and dark appearance.
Theme preference persists across refresh (localStorage) and applies on initial load.
No landing sections remain stuck in the wrong theme after toggling.

requirements.text: Store the 4 uploaded screenshot assets in the frontend as static files and reference them directly from landing components (do not route images through the backend).

quotes: We should use all 4 photos that were uploaded to replace all the current photos in the carousel.

acceptanceCriteria: Screenshot image files are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated (or a consistent landing asset folder under public) and loaded via direct /assets/... URLs.
No backend code changes are required for serving these landing images.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Do not edit immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend is single-actor Motoko; avoid backend changes unless strictly required (landing should remain static).
nonGoals: Do not add the uploaded screenshots to authenticated in-app pages (Home/Insights/Memories/etc.).
Do not introduce routing or additional pages for the landing refresh.
Do not add testimonials/social proof sections.

required: Apple touch icon matching tree-and-hearts style (apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png)
Mobile app screenshot image derived from IMG_1297.jpeg, resized/cropped (landing-screenshot-1.dim_390x844.jpg)
